features: ✅ 100Hrs Playtime (Long Battery TWS Earbuds): Enjoy up to 100 hours of total playtime (without ANC), making these bluetooth earbuds perfect for long travel, gaming, and all-day music without frequent charging.
✅ Fast Charging (Quick Charge Bluetooth Earbuds): Running low on battery? Just 10 minutes of Type-C fast charging gives hours of playback, ideal for users who need instant power on the go.
✅ ANC Support (Active Noise Cancellation Earbuds): Block out unwanted noise with ANC technology in these TWS earbuds, ensuring an immersive music and calling experience even in noisy environments.
✅ Dual Device Pairing (Smart Bluetooth Earbuds): Connect two devices simultaneously with dual pairing, allowing seamless switching between your smartphone and laptop.
✅ Bluetooth 5.4 (Latest Wireless Connectivity): Enjoy ultra-fast pairing, stable connection, and low latency with Bluetooth 5.4 for smooth calls, gaming, and streaming.
✅ Quad Mic ENC (Clear Calling Earbuds Bluetooth): Equipped with advanced Environmental Noise Cancellation, these wireless earbuds deliver crystal-clear voice calls by reducing background noise.
✅ 13mm Drivers (Deep Bass Wireless Earbuds): Experience powerful sound with 13mm dynamic drivers, delivering deep bass, crisp highs, and balanced audio for music, movies, and gaming.
✅ App Support (Customizable TWS Earbuds): Personalize your audio with app support — adjust EQ, controls, and sound settings for a tailored listening experience.
✅ Ergonomic & Stylish Design (Comfort Fit Earbuds): Designed for all-day comfort, these in-ear earbuds come in premium finishes and provide a secure fit for workouts, travel, and daily use.
✅ Type-C Charging & 1-Year Warranty (Reliable Earbuds): Featuring Type-C fast charging and backed by a 1-year warranty, these bluetooth wireless earbuds ensure durability and long-term performance.
